mapper.select: SELECT A.DETAIL_CODE_VALUE AS code , B.MESSAGE_CN AS name FROM CM_CODE_DETAIL A INNER JOIN CM_MESSAGE_LANG B ON B.LANG_KEY = A.CODE_LANG_KEY AND B.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD WHERE A.CODE_ID = 'CMMNCODE.572' AND A.USE_FL = 'Y' AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{companyCode} AND B.LANG_CODE = #{languageCode} ORDER BY A.SORTING_SQ ASC

SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.ROLE_CD AS roleCd , A.ROLE_NM AS roleNm , A.ROLE_TY AS roleTy , A.ROLE_PTTRN AS rolePttrn , A.ROLE_DC AS roleDc , A.ROLE_SORT AS roleSort , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS creationDt FROM CM_ROLE A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.ROLE_CD = #{roleCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_AUTHOR_ROLE_RELATE (CMPNY_CD, AUTHOR_CD, ROLE_CD, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT) VALUES (#{cmpnyCd}, #{authorCd}, #{roleCd}, #{creationId}, NOW())
